issue_context.title: builtinFunc InetAton/InetNtoa/Inet6Aton/Inet6Ntoa/IsIPv4/IsIPv4Compat/IsIPv4Mapped/IsIPv6 miss to fill pbCode
comments:
These functions are tagged as can be pushed down to TiKV (see [scalarExprSupportedByTiKV](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/expression/expression.go#L984)).

But there's a check for pbCode is not `tipb.ScalarFuncSig_Unspecified` at [canScalarFuncPushDown](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/expression/expression.go#L1164).

And these functions all miss to fill pbCode, so they can't be pushed down.

Fix plan:
1. fill pbCode in each function's `getFunction` method.
2. disable push down these functions in scalarExprSupportedByTiKV (I have concern about whether TiKV can correctly handle them since they are never pushed down).
3. Enable them in scalarExprSupportedByTiKV after they are fully tested in TiKV.
